svg.title: Order life cycle
svg.desc: One limit-order-based state machine. Accepted limit orders begin Open, Partially Filled or Filled. Open and Partially Filled can become Filled, Cancelled or Expired. Expired to Cancelled is a display-only update. Market execution outcomes are annotated below, not transitions from resting limit orders.
